SWARNAVA DUTTA

swarnava.dutta97@gmail.com | +91-7478893810 | linkedin.com/in/swarnava-dutta

Senior Generative AI Engineer with 5 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence. Spearheaded enterprise adoption of Agentic AI copilots, Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflows, and multimodal RAG systems for large-scale automation. Delivered production-grade copilots using LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex with LoRA/PEFT fine-tuning, deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Proficient in vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma) and backed by strong foundations in PySpark, Databricks, ADF, and MLOps (Docker, FastAPI, CI/CD).

EXPERIENCE

Senior Generative AI | Technical Lead	Jul 2025 - Present

Syren Technologies Private Limited

Led optimisation and scaling of a supply chain copilot with LangGraph, Pinecone, and FastAPI, serving 10K+ daily queries, reduced latency by 60%, and ensuring 99.9% uptime with resilient ingestion and monitoring pipelines.

Fine-tuned Mistral-7B with LoRA on supply chain datasets, boosting contextual recall by 35% and improving contract/invoice automation efficiency evaluated using BLEU/ROUGE-L (generation quality) and retrieval relevance metrics (recall@k).

Designed and managed dynamic context injection, prompt chaining, and secure orchestration using MCP in Gen AI workflows, improving multi-turn response accuracy by 28% and reducing context errors by 40%.

Senior Generative AI | Technical Lead	Jan 2024 - Jul 2025

RWS Moravia India Private Limited

Built the company’s first enterprise AI agent with LlamaIndex and LangChain, reducing manual knowledge lookup effort by 43%, benchmarking multilingual QA using BLEU, and integrating with Azure Cognitive Search for global adoption.

Built modular RAG pipelines integrating semantic embeddings and vector search, enhancing cross-language retrieval precision by 40%.

Migrated 18TB multilingual corpus from AWS MongoDB to Azure Data Lake with incremental loads, achieving 97% integrity, implementing Hugging Face embeddings with Azure Cognitive Search for semantic retrieval with NDCG-based relevance.

Junior Data Scientist	Jul 2022 - Dec 2023

BinaryERP Software Private Limited

Orchestrated pipelines to support embedding generation and lightweight text classification, enabling native semantic search prototypes adopted by 13 B2B users, while improving dataset usability by 26%.

Associate Data Engineer	Jan 2021 - Jul 2022

Capgemini Technology Services India Limited

Implemented delta-based ingestion into Azure Data Lake for a global banking client, gathering and refining data requirements, reducing nightly batch runtime by 95% and failures by 60%, ensuring compliance with strict financial SLAs.

SKILLS

GenAI and LLMs: RAG, Agentic AI, Model Context Protocol, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI, LoRA/PEFT, Prompt Engineering, BERT, T5, AI Agents

Evaluation Metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, Recall@k, NDCG, F1

Vector Databases and Search: Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Pgvector, Azure Cognitive Search

LLMOps: Git, Docker, Kubernetes, FastAPI, CI/CD, Airflow, Monitoring and Logging

Programming: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, SQL, Pandas, NumPy

Data Engineering: Azure Databricks, ADF, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure DevOps, PySpark

PROJECTS

Agentic AI Content Generator

Orchestrated an Agentic AI system using LangGraph to autonomously research and generate LinkedIn posts, reducing content creation time by 84% through parallel processing and boosting engagement via quality scoring and hook A/B testing.

Talksmith - RAG Chatbot

Led development of an in-house recruiter-assist AI tool using LlamaIndex, OpenAI embeddings, Pinecone, and FastAPI, evaluated with F1-score to validate extraction accuracy, showing consistent performance on internal datasets and reducing screening workload by 33% on 1k+ resumes.

Swiss Legal RAG chatbot

Developed a legal-tech chatbot for Swiss client, extending the dictation platform with a RAG chatbot for contract drafting and clause summarization. Built a secure ingestion and semantic chunking process, enabling 45% faster legal document turnaround while preserving GDPR compliance.

HR and Finance Data Integrated Chatbot

Developed a domain-specific AI assistant with Databricks ETL, LangChain, and Azure OpenAI, integrated into Cognitive Search, cutting routine HR queries by 40% and saving 200+ staff hours monthly.

EDUCATION

Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology	Aug 2016 - Jun 2020

Bachelor of Technology, Computer Science and Engineering
